headline.zh: 体验 AI 社交世界创作

scenario.zh: 访客选择一个虚拟身份主题，看到 AI 如何生成该角色的社交世界框架和互动场景示例
scenario.en: Visitor picks a virtual identity theme and sees how AI generates a social world framework and interaction scenario for that character

instruction.zh: 为你的 AI 角色选一个起点
instruction.en: Pick a starting point for your AI character

output.zh: 生成了暗网风格社交世界

input.zh: 代号 Cipher，擅长破解加密系统，常在地下论坛交易情报
input.en: Codename Cipher, skilled at cracking encryption, trades intel on underground forums

output.zh: 数字暗巷：匿名论坛、加密任务板、虚拟黑市三个社交空间；其他黑客可发布合作请求或挑战
output.en: Digital Alley: anonymous forum, encrypted mission board, virtual black market; other hackers post collaboration requests or challenges

output.zh: 生成了魔法学院社交世界

input.zh: 初学者 Lyra，正在学习元素魔法，喜欢和同学交流咒语心得
input.en: Beginner Lyra, learning elemental magic, enjoys sharing spell insights with classmates

output.zh: 水晶塔学院：图书馆讨论区、练习场、魔药实验室三个社交空间；同学可分享配方或组队试炼
output.en: Crystal Tower Academy: library discussion area, practice grounds, potion lab; classmates share recipes or team up for trials

output.zh: 生成了星际前哨社交世界

input.zh: 飞行员 Nova，驾驶小型侦察船，寻找未知星系中的资源星球
input.en: Pilot Nova, flying a scout ship, searching for resource planets in unknown systems

output.zh: 前哨站 Theta：补给码头、星图交易所、探险者酒吧三个社交空间；其他探险者可分享航线或求助维修
output.en: Outpost Theta: supply dock, star chart exchange, explorer's bar; other explorers share routes or request repairs

instruction.zh: 选择一个社交事件类型

output.zh: 其他角色可响应并组队
output.en: Other characters can respond and team up

output.zh: 开放技能交换或教学请求
output.en: Opens skill exchange or teaching request

output.zh: 触发偶然事件供其他人加入
output.en: Triggers chance event for others to join

takeaway.zh: 演示了 AI 如何根据虚拟身份生成社交世界结构和互动可能；实际产品的完整玩法、用户生成内容和社交机制需在 Status AI 平台体验
takeaway.en: Showed how AI generates social world structure and interaction possibilities from virtual identity; full gameplay, user-generated content, and social mechanics require the Status AI platform
